subject: Follow-up: KMS & encryption questions from FinBank
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: KMS & encryption questions from FinBank

Hi Evan —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the encryption/KMS items you raised on the call:

1) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant. I can share the most recent summary and the control coverage matrix.
2) Encryption: Data in transit is TLS 1.2+; at-rest encryption uses AES-256 by default.
3) Customer-managed keys: We support customer-managed keys (CMKs) via AWS KMS and we offer an HSM-backed option for Dedicated/Private deployments.
4) Questionnaire: happy to fill your vendor security questionnaire and loop in security for any detailed controls.

Next steps:
- I will attach our SOC 2 summary and a short KMS options doc for your review.
- Camila will join to answer any architecture/KMS integration questions.
- Can you send the vendor questionnaire file? If you prefer, we can take the first pass and return it within 3 business days.

Attachments: redwood_kms_options.md (overview), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary)

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

On Thu, Fri, or whatever, I’ll follow up if I don’t hear back by Monday.

From: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@finbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finbank.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up: KMS & encryption questions from FinBank

Aditya —

Thanks for the recap and for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications and requests from our side:

- Can you confirm SOC 2 Type II date range and whether Redwood will share the report under NDA? We typically require the SOC 2 report (not just the summary) for vendors storing customer data.
- For CMK support: we need details on key rotation, key lifecycle management, and whether Redwood ever has access to unwrapped keys. Please call out whether HSM is FIPS 140-2 validated and which providers are supported.
- Encryption at-rest: confirm whether full-disk encryption is used for GPU instances in Dedicated and Private deployments and whether we can bring our own keys in that mode.

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (FinBank_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Please fill the relevant tabs and return. Our security team will triage and may follow up with a short call. Timeline: we usually expect a first pass within 3 business days.

Evan
Evan Clarke
Director, Vendor Risk Management
FinBank
security@finbank.com
Attachment: FinBank_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: KMS & encryption questions from FinBank

Evan —

Thanks, received the questionnaire (thanks for including the team). High-level answers below; we'll complete the spreadsheet and return by EOD Wed (3 business days as requested). Camila and our Security PM will also add technical notes where helpful.

SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. We can share the full report under NDA — attaching the summary now and I'll send the report via DocuSign/NDA or secure link once we have an executed NDA.

CMK & HSM:
- We offer customer-managed keys via AWS KMS for Hosted and Dedicated. For Private (VPC/on-prem) and Dedicated HSM-backed options, we support HSM providers that are FIPS 140-2 validated; details will be added to the questionnaire.
- Key rotation: customers can control rotation schedules; Redwood does not automatically rewrap customer keys without explicit permission.
- Key access: Redwood does not retain plaintext unwrapped keys; we store wrapped keys and only use them in the service boundary for encryption/decryption operations as required by the workload.

At-rest encryption for Dedicated/Private:
- GPU instance storage and model caches are encrypted at-rest (AES-256). For Dedicated pools, full-disk encryption is available and can be provisioned with customer keys in Private deployments.

Attachments included: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_kms_options.md. We'll return the completed FinBank_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx with per-tab notes and any supporting docs by close of business Wednesday.

If your security team wants a quick walkthrough of the answers, Camila can join a 30-minute technical review.

Best —
Aditya

--
